abstract: BACKGROUND: A case of testicular typical seminoma associated with bilateral undescended testes in Down's syndrome is reported. A 42-year-old institutionalized male patient developed left testicular seminoma with retroperitoneal metastasis. METHODS/RESULTS: Neither adjuvant chemotherapy nor radiotherapy were performed due to his severe mental retardation. He died as a result of the cancer 2 years after a left radical orchiectomy and an autopsy was carried out. DISCUSSION: Recently an increase in the incidence of the association of testicular tumors and Down's syndrome has been repeatedly documented. Thirty-six cases of testicular tumors associated with Down's syndrome have been reported and of these 17.1% had cryptorchidism. This is a much lower percentage considering the high risk of cryptorchidism in males with Down's syndrome. The relationship between testicular germ cell tumors associated with cryptorchidism and Down's syndrome is discussed.

背景：ダウン症候群の男性で、両側の停留精巣に合併した精巣セミノーマの症例を報告する。42歳の施設入所中の男性が、後腹膜転移を伴う左精巣セミノーマを発症した。
方法・結果：重度の知的障害のため、補助化学療法も放射線療法も施行されなかった。左根治的精巣摘除術を受けた後、2年後にがんで死亡し、剖検が行われた。
考察：近年、精巣腫瘍とダウン症候群の合併が増加していることが繰り返し報告されている。これまでにダウン症候群に伴う精巣腫瘍は36例が報告されており、そのうち17.1%に停留精巣を認めた。ダウン症候群の男性では停留精巣のリスクが高いことを考えると、この割合は著しく低い。停留精巣を伴う胚細胞腫瘍とダウン症候群との関係について考察する。
